dialogue.text: Still struggling? How... charming. Your futile hope is almost as amusing as his resistance.
Her voice... it's like acid... digging into my head. I can feel her smiling.
Dad, listen to me! Fight her! Remember Mum! Remember what she'd want you to do!
Oh, he remembers his precious Star, child. Remembers how frail she was, how she faded. Just like your resistance will.
And as for you, Love's little creation... perhaps a reunion with your old 'therapist' is in order?
I WILL TEAR YOU THE FUCK APART!
Hahahaha! Such fire! The spitting image of her mother. Now, Xerberus. Erase it.
